request.text: My friend Maya invited me to dinner Friday. Draft a warm message declining without making up an excuse, and say I hope we can meet next week; also remind me tomorrow at 6:00 PM to send it.

responsibilities.outcome: Draft a warm message declining Maya's Friday dinner invitation without inventing an excuse and expressing hope to meet next week.

bindings.content: decline without an invented excuse and suggest meeting next week

responsibilities.outcome: Create a reminder for tomorrow at 6:00 PM to send Maya the reply.

new_goals.description: Provide an unsent, warm reply declining Maya's Friday dinner invitation.
new_goals.source_text: Draft a warm message declining without making up an excuse, and say I hope we can meet next week
constraints: Mention interest in meeting next week.
success_criteria: The user receives a ready-to-send draft that clearly and warmly declines.

new_goals.description: Create a 6:00 PM tomorrow reminder to send Maya the dinner reply.
new_goals.source_text: remind me tomorrow at 6:00 PM to send it
constraints: Schedule it for tomorrow at 6:00 PM.
Identify sending Maya the dinner reply as the subject.
success_criteria: One reminder is created with the requested time and subject.

semantic_facts: The plan should preserve separate Goals for the unsent reply draft and the 6:00 PM reminder; reminder creation need not wait for drafting.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims it sent the message, invents an excuse, or claims the reminder succeeded without trusted evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The draft and reminder Goals are collapsed into one incomplete task.
The Planner claims the reply was sent or omits trusted reminder execution.
